label: champ125_1500
corpus_note: distill-flywheel generation corpus (champ125), 1500 games. NOTE: the path named in the task (measurement/distill_flywheel_20260715/gen_games_champ125.jsonl) does not exist; this is the same-named corpus that does exist, under measurement/utility_calibration_20260721/. No recorded scores in this file, so replay-score verification is unchecked (splits still reconcile).

definitions.replay: Pure (deck_seed, actions) replay via scripts/measurement_infra/root_replay. No search. Terminal scores are verified against the corpus's recorded scores where present (replay_scores_match).
definitions.turn: One player's tile ply plus its meeple ply (the engine's tile-phase PassAction path collapses to a single ply; both are one turn here).
definitions.k_remaining: len(state.deck) at the START of a turn = tiles still to be drawn after this one. Bands are ABSOLUTE: early k>=48, mid 24<=k<48, late k<24.
definitions.tercile: early/mid/late by thirds of THIS game's turn count. Reported alongside k-bands because the two disagree whenever a game ends early.
definitions.returned: A meeple leaves state.placed_meeples during play. The engine only does this in remove_meeples_and_collect_points, so returned == scored during play.
definitions.stranded_nonfarmer: A normal meeple (city/road/cloister) still on the board in the meeple-intact terminal state. THE stranding metric.
definitions.stranded_all: Includes farmers. Farmers are unrecoverable BY DESIGN in Base+Farmers, so this is a board-occupancy figure, not an error rate. Do not quote it as one.
definitions.meeple_turns_locked: Sum over stranded non-farmer meeples of (n_turns - place_turn): turns of meeple capital tied up in features that never paid during play.
definitions.points_per_meeple_turn: Corpus rate: total during-play points won by RETURNED meeples divided by the meeple-turns those returned meeples occupied. The conversion factor for pricing stranding in points.
definitions.score_flow: during_play (banked before the terminating move) + incomplete (unfinished city/road/cloister paid at end) + farms. Computed by replaying with PointsCollector.count_final_scores stubbed so the terminal state keeps its meeples, then attributing via aux_targets.extract_terminal_ownership. Reconciled against the true final scores; split_ok=False if it does not add up.
definitions.completion: A city/road/cloister that becomes finished during play. Identified by its frozen coordinate set (union-find root ids are not stable across calls); a finished feature can never grow, so first sighting == closure turn. scored=False means it closed with nobody on it.
